pages.name: Top Bar & Left Sidebar Chrome
issues_found: Auto-Speak label text wrapped to 2 lines ('AUTO-' and 'SPEAK') stretching box to 48px height
input selector lacked checkbox/radio CSS reset, causing checkbox to inherit width: 100% and 8px 12px padding
Sidebar body > nav bottom padding was only 16px, causing bottom navigation items to scroll underneath the fixed #sidebar-operator-card
Missing favicon link in index.html head causing transient 404 for /favicon.ico
fixes_applied: Added explicit CSS reset for input[type='checkbox'], input[type='radio'] (width: auto, padding: 0, margin: 0)
Styled #hdr-auto-speak-label with white-space: nowrap, flex-shrink: 0, height: 32px to match top bar pill height
Updated body > nav with padding: 104px 10px 80px and overflow-y: auto, giving 64px+ clearance above operator card
Added <link rel='icon' type='image/png' href='/jarvis_icon.png'> and created static/favicon.ico
